## Pull request overview

This PR transforms the Object UI Studio homepage from a marketing-focused landing page to a professional development tool interface, aligning it with industry-standard IDEs like VS Code and Figma.

**Changes:**
- Simplified header styling with reduced height (64px → 56px) and minimalist button design
- Removed hero section including marketing copy, decorative animations, and excessive whitespace
- Replaced pill-style category buttons with tab-based navigation featuring VS Code-style bottom borders
- Increased template grid density (3 → 4 columns) with cleaner, more compact card designs

The count badge always uses muted text color regardless of the active state. Consider making it inherit or adapt to the tab's active state color for better visual hierarchy. When a tab is active (text-primary), the count could also use a primary-related color to maintain visual consistency.

The "New Design" button in the Quick Actions section duplicates the "New" button in the header, creating redundant functionality. Consider whether both actions are necessary, or if the Quick Actions section should feature different starter actions (e.g., "Open Recent", "Browse Templates").
